name: Biswa Kalyan Rath - Extroverts and Chaos
description:
Insaan apne gusse ko comedy ke madhyam se channelise kar raha hai. Baaki log theatre main khub relate kar raha hai aur agree kar rahe hai ki samaj ke taur tareekon se tadpe woh bhi hain. 

Soundtrack: Nucleya BASS Rani - Aaja. (https://twitter.com/NUCLEYA)
